# Evan Jacobson

> Official portfolio and resume of Evan Jacobson, a Denver-based AI and software engineer focused on reliable agents, multi-agent systems, coding-agent infrastructure, and production LLM applications.

- Canonical site: https://evanjacobson.io/
- Contact: contact@evanjacobson.io
- Location: Denver, Colorado, United States
- Current work: Software Engineer at Kilo; Technical Cofounder at OrAI

## Selected AI engineering work

- [OneDeal](https://evanjacobson.io/work/onedeal): Autonomous business-sourcing agents and an agentic web-search pipeline.
- [Trade Intel](https://evanjacobson.io/work/trade-intel): Multi-agent financial newsletter extraction pipeline.
- [Beads](https://evanjacobson.io/work/beads): Persistent structured memory for AI coding agents.
- [OrAI](https://evanjacobson.io/work/orai): Production AI applications for early childhood educators and administrators.
- [Kilo](https://evanjacobson.io/work/kilo): Work on KiloClaw and an open-source agentic engineering platform.
